text: そういえば　となりの　オーキドはかせが　あなたを　よんでたわよ

structure.jp: となりの　オーキドはかせが　あなたを　よんでたわよ
structure.en: Professor Oak next door was calling for you

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた says something was going on. Here it is shortened to てた, as people do when speaking. よんでた = 'was calling for you'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end gives a soft, womanly tone, and よ adds 'I'm telling you'. よんでたわよ = 'he was calling for you, you know'.
